about: What each tournament buy puts in the prize pool (#118; decisions 0200, 0203). An entry, re-entry or rebuy costs the tournament's buy-in, which holds its fee; an add-on costs its own price, which holds its own fee. The fee is the club's revenue (venue.tournament_fees); the rest is players' money in the prize pool (venue.tournament_pool) until the prizes are paid. A fee is nothing or more and always less than the price; anything else is refused. Amounts are whole rupees in ₹50 chips.

cases.description: RIVR Sunday: ₹10,000 with a ₹1,000 fee puts ₹9,000 in the pool.
An add-on with no fee puts all of its ₹2,000 in the pool.
At the ₹50 boundary: ₹1,050 with a ₹50 fee puts ₹1,000 in.
The smallest pool share: ₹100 with a ₹50 fee puts ₹50 in.
A fee as large as the price is refused: nothing would reach the pool.
A fee below nothing is refused.
